an3.57:1.8: Those who say, worthy Gotama, ‘the ascetic Gotama says this:
an3.57:1.9: “Gifts should only be given to me, not to others.
an3.57:1.10: Gifts should only be given to my disciples, not to the disciples of others.
an3.57:1.11: Only what is given to me is very fruitful, not what is given to others.
an3.57:1.12: Only what is given to my disciples is very fruitful, not what is given to the disciples of others.”’
an3.57:2.4: not to the disciples of others.”’
